hook.name: WethFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: An immutable Uniswap v4 hook that charges a WETH-denominated fee on every swap using per-token tiers (3%, 5%, or 10%) from a launchpad registry, or a global fallback rate. Accrued fees are held as ERC-6909 claims and distributed via a permissionless distribute() call that splits proceeds between the token creator, treasury, a flagship buyback vault, and the token's on-chain mechanism.
